title: Field type package
description: Field types as data: what an editor offers when adding a field, and the property a new field starts from. The core package is types/core.json; other packages (dk, banking, …) are installed alongside it and prefix their kinds with the package name.

functions.description: A module, relative to this file, whose default export is { name: fn }: the checks and operators the types use

group.description: Where the editor lists it: Answers, Choices, Contact, Content, Advanced, or a group of the package's own

keywords.description: Extra words the editor's search finds it by

privacy.description: The privacy a new field of this type starts with

settings.description: Which settings the editor's inspector shows besides label, id, help, required, hidden, privacy and step
